name: App Orchestrator
description: Root application orchestrator. Creates CanvasArea, TopBar, and all modals (Welcome, About, Theme, Tutorial). Handles keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+N new window, Ctrl+W close tab, Ctrl+Tab card cycling, Ctrl+P file search, Ctrl+J new terminal). Manages workspace lifecycle: checks CLI path, shows WelcomeModal if none, loads/saves state to .cockpit/window.json, restores grid style/zoom lock preferences. Debounced auto-save on state change via JSON diff comparison. Bridges TopBar menu actions to CanvasArea operations.
